mapper.insert: INSERT INTO paper_portfolio_profit_loss ( account_no, stock_code, base_date, evaluation_type, start_asset_amount, end_asset_amount, realized_profit_loss, unrealized_profit_loss, return_rate, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{accountNo}, #{stockCode}, #{baseDate}, #{evaluationType}, #{startAssetAmount}, #{endAssetAmount}, #{realizedProfitLoss}, #{unrealizedProfitLoss}, #{returnRate}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE end_asset_amount = VALUES(end_asset_amount), realized_profit_loss = VALUES(realized_profit_loss), unrealized_profit_loss = VALUES(unrealized_profit_loss), return_rate = VALUES(return_rate), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, account_no, stock_code, base_date, evaluation_type, start_asset_amount, end_asset_amount, realized_profit_loss, unrealized_profit_loss, return_rate, created_at, updated_at FROM paper_portfolio_profit_loss WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} ORDER BY base_date DESC, updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
